canonical_name: No Information Security in Supplier Agreements
description: Supplier agreements do not establish relevant information security requirements based on supply relationship type.
applicability: Applies when an organization has supplier agreements that lack adequate information security requirements, terms, and conditions appropriate to the type of supplier relationship and the information assets that may be accessed, processed, stored, communicated, or provided.

metadata.detection_notes: Review supplier contracts and agreements for information security clauses, verify security requirements are defined based on supplier access levels, check for security obligations and SLA definitions, assess incident response and breach notification terms.
